metadata.purpose: Predict mainline-one S1B target state: page64 + write-back + best_effort.
metadata.mainline_one_config_novelty: S1B must be distinct from S1A and from every previously profiled HiCache state config, not only from the C0-C8 named matrix.
metadata.mainline_one_config_comparison: Different from C3/I2 page64 by write policy, prefetch policy, ratio, and timeout extra config; different from C1/C8 write-back by page size, capacity, prefetch policy, ratio, and timeout extra config; different from earlier mainline-one S1B drafts by ratio, L2 capacity, and timeout extra config; no matching joint signature was found in the current matrix or cleaned historical HiCache state validation records.
